description:
Stop tracking one of this account's extensions, using an extension_id from list_extensions.
Remove only the extension the user asked to remove; clarify ambiguous names first.
Never remove an extension automatically to make room at a plan limit.

This deletes this account's extension record, notes, keyword tracking and competitor
configuration for it, across both stores. Re-adding does not restore that configuration.
Shared store listings, collected metrics/rank history and other users' tracking remain.
A missing or already removed id returns the same error as another account's id.

Needs an ExtensionDash account: sign in from your app, e.g. `claude mcp login extensions-dashboard` or `codex mcp login extensions-dashboard`.

extension_id.description: The user's chosen extension_id from list_extensions.

name: remove_extension
title: Remove extension
